overview: Retallack Resort and Spa is an inland lodge resort at Winnard's Perch, about three miles north of St Columb Major. Lodges sleep larger groups, some with hot tubs, and the site has a spa, indoor pool, restaurant, bar, aquapark, wake park and a FlowRider surf simulator. The north coast beaches are roughly a 20-minute drive away.
surfTripFit: Better for activity-focused family groups than dedicated surfers: real surf beaches need a car, though the FlowRider offers practice on site.
